economic_rationale: Recent cross-sectional losers exhibit positive subsequent returns when market conditions favor mean reversion (elevated cross-sectional dispersion), while the effect weakens or disappears during persistent momentum regimes. Isolates the long-side alpha observed in EQ-004 without shorting runaway momentum leaders.
documented_caveats: Commission rate in L1 simulator is evaluated on dollar turnover against assumed share price baseline ($100), rather than exact per-share counts.
EQ-004 dollar-neutral model was not strictly beta-neutral; EQ-005 eliminates the short leg entirely to isolate long laggard excess return vs cash and random controls.
